citation: Dumelle et al. (2024). SSN2: The next generation of spatial stream network modeling in R. JOSS 9(99), 6389. https://doi.org/10.21105/joss.06389
description: SSN2 is an R package published by US Environmental Protection Agency researchers and collaborators for spatial statistical modelling on stream networks. It fits responses to explanatory variables using network-aware covariance structures, including flow-connected, downstream and Euclidean dependence, and predicts at unobserved locations. Inputs describe a stream network, observations and covariates; outputs include fitted models, predictions and graphical summaries. Coverage is global and user-defined, with spatial and temporal detail inherited from the sampling design. Public code, CRAN installation and worked examples are free under GPL-3.0. A limitation is that covariance choices and available observations determine inference; statistical prediction is not a mechanistic simulation of pollutant transport. The package can help interpolate water-quality conditions and calibrate scenarios for drinking-water or watershed infrastructure studies. It complements the HAWQS modelling environment (platform-hawqs-hydrologic-water-quality-system). The 2024 JOSS article describes the successor to the earlier SSN package. This review did not fit a network model or download monitoring data.
name: SSN2 spatial stream-network modelling
